title.en: From Turing Machines to Large Language Models

summary.zh-CN: 沿计算理论、网络与数据、机器学习和深度学习的历史脉络，理解大语言模型的形成，并连接其数学基础与 Agent 系统。
summary.en: Trace computation, networks and data, machine learning, and deep learning to understand the formation of large language models and their connections to mathematics and agent systems.
